mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(email) FROM USER WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT COUNT(nickname) FROM USER WHERE nickname = #{nickname}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER ( user_name, email, password, nickname, is_terms_agreed, is_privacy_agreed, is_marketing_agreed ) VALUES ( #{userName}, #{email}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{termsAgreed}, #{privacyAgreed}, #{marketingAgreed} );
mapper.select: SELECT email, password FROM USER WHERE email = #{email}

SELECT u.user_id, u.email, u.password, u.nickname, r.role_code as roleCode FROM USER u LEFT JOIN USER_ROLE ur ON u.user_id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN ROLE r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id WHERE u.email = #{email}
SELECT email FROM USER WHERE user_name = #{userName} AND nickname= #{nickname}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN (user_id, token_hash, expires_at) SELECT u.user_id, #{token}, DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR) FROM USER u WHERE u.email = #{email} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE token_hash = #{token}, expires_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)
mapper.select: SELECT u.email AS email, t.expires_at AS expiresAt, t.token_hash AS tokenHash, t.used_at AS usedAt, t.created_at FROM USER u JOIN PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN t ON u.user_id = t.user_id WHERE t.token_hash = #{token} AND t.used_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN SET used_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = (SELECT user_id FROM USER WHERE email = #{email}) AND used_at IS NULL
UPDATE PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN SET token_hash = NULL, expires_at = NULL WHERE user_id = (SELECT user_id FROM USER WHERE email = #{email})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AUTO_LOGIN ( user_id, token_hash, expired_at, last_used_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{refreshToken}, #{expiryDate}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE token_hash = #{refreshToken}, expired_at = #{expiryDate}, last_used_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT al.token_hash FROM AUTO_LOGIN al INNER JOIN USER u ON u.user_id = al.user_id WHERE u.email = #{email} AND al.token_hash IS NOT NULL AND (al.expired_at IS NULL OR al.expired_at > NOW()) LIMIT 1
